description: This Java class defines an Android refactoring action for extracting layout tags into include files within an IDE environment, specifically for Android development in IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio.

classes.name: AndroidExtractAsIncludeAction
classes.description: A class providing an IDE refactoring action to extract selected layout XML tags into a separate include layout file in Android projects.

classes.name: MyTestConfig
classes.description: A nested static class used for testing configurations, holding the filename for the layout to be created during tests.

methods.name: doRefactorForTags
methods.description: Performs the refactoring operation on selected XML tags, extracting them into a new layout resource file.

methods.name: isEnabledForTags
methods.description: Checks if the refactoring action is applicable/enabled for the given set of XML tags.

methods.name: doRefactorForPsiRange
methods.description: Executes the refactoring process on a specified range of PSI elements, creating a new layout file and replacing the range with an include tag.

methods.name: doRefactor
methods.description: Handles the actual modification of the XML document, creating the new layout file, updating namespace prefixes, and inserting the include tag.

methods.name: collectAllTags
methods.description: Collects all XML tags within a specified PSI range.

methods.name: isEnabledForPsiRange
methods.description: Determines if the refactoring is enabled for a range of PSI elements.

methods.name: isSuitableDomElement
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is suitable for extraction (either a LayoutViewElement or Include).
